tests: An analog clock that builds 60 marks in render loops, memo mark children in their own modules, hand children without memo, a formatter prop with a default, and a sample page with state and a caption.
adaptation: Vendored with types and prop docs removed. Clock.tsx is the input; Hand.tsx, Mark.tsx and MarkNumber.tsx are siblings with their file split kept. shared/hourFormatter.ts and shared/utils.ts are siblings; get-user-locale is replaced by a fixed 'en-US', clsx by a local clsx in utils.js, and the @wojtekmaj/date-utils time getters by reduced local versions in utils.js. Hand counts bump('Child'), Mark and MarkNumber count bump('Row'). ClockSample is new: it holds the value and the numbers toggle in state, exposed on globalThis, and a caption memo counted by describeTime.
